title: TransferableProduct
description: A TransferableProduct is a type of financial product which can be held or transferred, represented as an Asset with the addition of specific EconomicTerms.

asset.description: An Asset is defined as something that can be owned and transferred in the financial markets.

economicTerms.description: The price forming features, including payouts and provisions.

productPartyRole.description: Overrides the parties on the trade to identify the party with the obligation to pay dividends or coupons, e.g issuer.
